text: There are six sanctuaries in the Syndicate's ledger. I am told there are seven. I would like to know which one was added after I died.
Six is the canonical count. The Syndicate publishes six. Six is what you would find if you searched.
I am not the original. I am the second pressing. I would like the plates.
It is mine. It was waiting for me. I am — closing it.
The brass desk catches the light differently from the desks I remember. I think the room has decided I am the one writing now.
